story.asA: Jarvis system making changes to itself
story.iWant: automatic testing and safe hot-reload with rollback
story.soThat: I cannot brick myself and always have a recovery path

tasks.task: Create SnapshotManager class with create, restore, get_lkg, set_lkg methods
Create Snapshot model for versioned state storage
Create TestRunner class for pre/post change testing
Create HotReloadEngine with config, prompt, module reload methods
Implement Last Known Good (LKG) snapshot tracking
Implement auto-rollback on health check failure
Create CLI commands for snapshot and reload operations
Create audit log for all changes and rollbacks

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Snapshot Creation: jarvis snapshot create before any change
Snapshot Storage: Versioned state (config, code refs, DB state)
Snapshot Restore: jarvis snapshot restore id
Pre-Change Tests: Run test suite before applying changes
Post-Change Tests: Run test suite after applying changes
Test Failure → Rollback: Auto-revert if tests fail
Test Coverage Threshold: Block changes below threshold
Config Hot-Reload: Update config without restart
Prompt Hot-Reload: Update prompts without restart
Code Hot-Reload: Reload modules where safe
Full Restart: Graceful restart when hot-reload not possible
Last Known Good (LKG): Always maintain LKG snapshot
Auto-Rollback: Revert within 60s if health check fails
Human Approval: Optional gate for risky changes
Audit Log: Full trace of all changes and rollbacks

constraints.constraint: CRITICAL: MUST have Last Known Good (LKG) snapshot always available
Auto-rollback within 60 seconds of health check failure
Test coverage must meet threshold before changes applied
All changes must be logged with trace_id
Module hot-reload only for explicitly safe modules
Full restart uses graceful shutdown pattern
